Class DisposalCostEstimator

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.DisposalCostEstimator
@Service public class DisposalCostEstimator extends Object
Estimates the costs of the hypothetical sale with which the reports value an open position: the commission of the fee model, the transaction tax of the simulation tax models and the markup of converting the proceeds into the currency of the settlement cash account. Personal income and capital gains taxes are out of scope.

The rules are evaluated by the same estimators the historical replay uses, so a report and a simulation price a sale identically: FeeModelResolver, TransactionCostEvalExEstimator, TaxEvalExEstimator and FxMarkupEngine. Unlike the replay, which stops on a fee model that cannot answer, a report never fails: a missing model, a missing rule or an unknown required input marks the affected component as incomplete, with the reason, and an unknown cost is never taken as zero.

The estimate is switched on by the global parameter gt.disposal.cost.estimate, and a tenant can switch it off for itself (Tenant.isDisposalCostEstimate()); it is effective only while both are on, otherwise newCollectorIfEnabled(Integer) and therefore newSession(LocalDate, DisposalPositionCollector) return null. A session belongs to one report and resolves the fee model of each security account and the tax models only once.

  • Method Details

    • isEnabled

      public boolean isEnabled(Integer idTenant)
      Whether the estimate applies to the reports of a tenant: the global parameter must switch it on and the tenant must not have switched it off. A simulation tenant follows its main tenant, whose flag is the one the user edits.
      Parameters:
      idTenant - the tenant of the report, passed explicitly because reports may run outside the request thread
      Returns:
      true when the estimate is effective for the tenant

    • newCollectorIfEnabled

      public DisposalPositionCollector newCollectorIfEnabled(Integer idTenant)
      Parameters:
      idTenant - the tenant of the report
      Returns:
      a collector for a report, null while the estimate is not effective for the tenant

    • newSession

      public DisposalCostEstimator.Session newSession(LocalDate date, DisposalPositionCollector collector)
      Opens the estimate of one report.
      Parameters:
      date - the report date, the day of the hypothetical sale
      collector - the units, settlement currencies and trades collected while the report walked the transactions; null when the estimate is switched off
      Returns:
      the session, null when the collector is null
